name: David Miller
psychographics: Values time above all else; believes paying for convenience is an investment in mental health, not a luxury
current_solutions: HelloFresh meal kits for dinners, HelloFresh for lunch boxes at school, Amazon Prime for everything, a local dry cleaner that offers pickup service
frustration: Tried to return a faulty robot vacuum to the high street retailer at 4pm on a Tuesday; the returns desk was closed, the queue was 15 people deep, and he had to reschedule the whole afternoon
decision_style: Checks the 'subscribe & save' box immediately; if it arrives on time and works, he never thinks about the price again
voice: Blunt, businesslike, and clipped. Uses phrases like 'just get it done' and 'why faff about?'
